title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 415 North Main Street in Henning, Tennessee, as the "Paula Croom Robinson and Judy Spray Memorial Post Office Building".
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 415 North Main Street in Henning, Tennessee, as the "Paula Croom Robinson and Judy Spray Memorial Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Names a Tennessee post office building in Henning after two local women, Paula Croom Robinson and Judy Spray.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 415 North Main Street in Henning, Tennessee. The building will be called the "Paula Croom Robinson and Judy Spray Memorial Post Office Building." It is an honorary designation and does not change postal services, rules, or staffing.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 21, 2020, and the designation took effect on that date.
